title_en: It's Never Too Late for Love
milestones: A group of singles aged 50 and older enter the pods hoping to find true love based purely on connection.
Connections deepen in the pods leading to emotional revelations, romantic proposals, and first face-to-face reveals.

title_en: It Takes a Long Time to Become Young
title_original: Demora muito tempo pra ficar jovem
milestones: The remaining singles navigate final connections and proposals before the pod experiment concludes.
The newly engaged 50+ couples meet face-to-face and get ready for their romantic getaway.
Celebrity guest commentary pairs watch and react to the pod dates and proposals.
The engaged couples travel to Trancoso, Bahia, to test their physical chemistry and bond in paradise.
Couples enjoy retreat activities while confronting personal differences and lifestyle expectations.
The couples return to São Paulo and move into shared apartments, navigating daily routines and family dynamics.
Couples go dress and suit shopping, test their readiness for marriage, and meet each other's inner circles.
Celebrity commentators analyze the cohabitation phase and ongoing relationship drama.
The singles celebrate their bachelor and bachelorette parties as final wedding nerves kick in.
The couples walk down the aisle to decide whether to say 'I do' or walk away forever.
Celebrity guest hosts react to the emotional wedding outcomes and final decisions.
